_comment: MENDELEEV S2 row 2 full-FT recovery (spec 11.2: exact fp32 Adam on a 3-4B model = 64 GB + activations -> the 1x80 GB class; Hopper ONLY: compute_cap in [800,1000) + expected_gpu H100 asserted at boot, so the Vast lane is one hardware class (spec confound 27)). weights_mode download = fast-pipe offer filter; WEIGHTS_HF_REPO is left empty on purpose — the job pulls its own models through the hub in-run (cells/mdl_job.py). Smoke first: 1 item/subject, n_boot 10, must bank metrics.json and exit 0 before the real cell runs. Image = pinned deps + code, no weights; rent-time code tar overrides /app. {BEH_METRICS_S3} is substituted at rent time with the row's behaviour-cell metrics.json S3 URL (dose-0 identity, spec 6.6); scripts/matrix_launch.py prints the filled manifest path.
